pages.text: This chapter covers all objectives that are available within Vaults.$(br2)Applying a $(l)seal$() to a Vault Crystal $(l)forces$() the objective of a Vault, while unsealed Vault Crystals can roll $(l)one of several$() objectives.$(br2)After completing the objective of a Vault, a $(l)Completion Crate$() of that objective is awarded.

pages.title: Hunter: Observer
pages.text: $(br)The $(l)Hunter$() specialization for $(l)Objective$() can be used to find the Objectives within a Vault.$(br2)This includes $(l)God Altars$(), more on which can be found $(l:the_vault/altars)here$().

pages.title: Unsealed crystals
pages.text: Unsealed crystals start with $(l)Elixir$(). Braziers join the pool at $(l)level 10$() and Scavenger Hunt at 20.$(br2)From $(l)level 50$() you can also roll Rune Boss or Bingo.

pages.title: Light the Braziers
pages.text: Look at a $(l)Brazier$() to see its modifier, right click it and $(l)control the ring$() while mobs attack. A mob in the ring pauses it.$(br2)Every lit Brazier makes mobs stronger and unlocks better modifiers.$(br2)Once enough are lit, $(l)exit$() through the portal.

pages.title: Elixir
pages.text: Fill the $(l)Elixir bar$() by looting chests, mining ores and killing mobs. $(br2)The amount of elixir contributed by every action $(l)differs per run$().$(br2)$(l)Small purple Elixir balls$() indicate how much Elixir is provided by a task, and $(l)don't$() need to be picked up.

pages.title: Elixir
pages.text: Once everyone’s Elixir bar is full, each player can use the same $(l)Lodestone$() to finish.$(br2)Use a $(l)Seal of the Sage$() to choose Elixir.

pages.title: Scavenger Hunt
pages.text: Pick up the items on your $(l)HUD$(). Each one counts straight away, and the HUD shows where to find the ones you still need.

pages.title: Scavenger Hunt
pages.text: Your whole party shares one list. Once it’s full, use any Scavenger Altar with a $(l)green beam$() to finish.$(br2)A $(l)Seal of the Hunter$() gives your crystal this objective.

pages.title: Rune Boss
pages.text: Collect runes to build $(l)Fury$(). At the altar, choose how much Fury to feed the boss.$(br2)More Fury can mean a better crate and a nastier fight.

pages.title: Rune Boss
pages.text: $(l)Sealed Runes$() carry items. Feed one to the altar to put its item in your crate, then beat the boss to earn it.$(br2)Use a $(l)Seal of the Executioner$() to choose Rune Boss.

pages.title: Cake Hunt
pages.text: Find the cakes scattered around the rooms.$(br2)$(l)Pink fog$() appears when the player is near a cake.$(br2)The number of cakes is $(l)unlimited$(). With each room, the player gets further away from the starting room, as Vaults with this objective have a $(l)spiral$() room pattern.

pages.title: Cake Hunt
pages.text: Use a $(l)Crake Pedestal$() to finish your Cake Hunt. In co-op, each player needs a fresh pedestal.

pages.title: Cake Hunt
pages.text: Put a $(l)Glazed Vault Rock$() on a $(l)Vault Altar$() to make a Cake Crystal.

pages.title: Cake Hunt
pages.text: Each cake adds a $(l)Cake Layer$(). Later rooms offer more loot and tougher mobs, and your Crake can hold more rewards.$(br2)How many rooms are you willing to push?

pages.title: Adding rooms
pages.text: For a room of your choice, add its inscription to a Vault Crystal at the $(l)Crystal Workbench$(). Check the rooms and capacity on the preview before taking the crystal.

pages.title: The Final Challenge
pages.text: Ready for the $(l)final challenge$()?$(br2)More to come ...

pages.title: Collector
pages.text: Pick up the scavenger items on your board. Complete one line to finish.$(br2)The Seal of the Collector gives you a 4×4 board and the Seal of the Big Collector gives you a 5×5.

pages.title: Chaos
pages.text: You get timed tasks in the Chaos theme. Finish a task for a blessing. Miss it and you get a curse.$(br2)Use a Seal of Chaos to choose this objective.
